---
title: "Final nuclear assembly quality"
output: html_document
---

Table 1 uses the mitochondrial-filtered nuclear assemblies after the SC1982 gap split.
Run stages 04 and 05 first. Rendering this report does not modify assemblies.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
quality_file <- here("data", "qc_final_assemblies", "quality_final_assemblies.tsv")
if (!file.exists(quality_file)) stop("Run workflow/05-assembly-qc/qc-final-assemblies.sh first")
quality <- read_tsv(quality_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
reference <- read_tsv(here("data", "qc_published_genomes", "quality_published_genomes.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(file == "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013")
stopifnot(nrow(quality) == 4, nrow(reference) == 1, !anyDuplicated(quality$file))
# The current manuscript revision uses the 475-contig SC1982 assembly.
sc1982 <- filter(quality, file == "Pseudoperonospora_cubensis_SC1982")
stopifnot(nrow(sc1982) == 1, sc1982[["# contigs (>= 0 bp)"]] == 475,
          sc1982[["Total length (>= 0 bp)"]] == 103498600)
table1 <- bind_rows(quality, reference) |>
  transmute(Assembly = file, `Size (Mb)` = `Total length` / 1e6,
    Contigs = `# contigs`, `N50 (Mb)` = N50 / 1e6, L50,
    `N90 (Mb)` = N90 / 1e6, L90, `GC (%)`,
    `Complete BUSCO (%)` = parse_number(S) + parse_number(D),
    `Single BUSCO (%)` = parse_number(S), `Duplicated BUSCO (%)` = parse_number(D))
write_tsv(table1, here("data", "qc_final_assemblies", "table1.tsv"))
```

```{r table1, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(table1, digits = 2)
```

QUAST's `# contigs` and `Total length` use its minimum-length threshold; the split
validation above uses the all-contig columns. Compleasm uses the stramenopiles lineage.
